CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp._cp3_r4_reverse_journal_internal(p_journal_entry_id uuid, p_reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'erp', 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_old erp.journal_entries%ROWTYPE;v_new_id uuid;v_lines jsonb; BEGIN PERFORM erp.require_internal(); SELECT * INTO v_old FROM erp.journal_entries WHERE id=p_journal_entry_id FOR UPDATE; IF v_old.id IS NULL OR v_old.status<>'POSTED' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only posted journal can be reversed'; END IF; SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('account_id',jl.account_id,'debit',jl.credit,'credit',jl.debit,'description','Reversal: '||COALESCE(jl.description,''),'customer_id',jl.customer_id,'vendor_id',jl.vendor_id,'contractor_id',jl.contractor_id,'po_id',jl.po_id,'product_id',jl.product_id)) INTO v_lines FROM erp.journal_lines jl WHERE jl.journal_entry_id=p_journal_entry_id; v_new_id:=erp.post_journal('JOURNAL_REVERSAL',p_journal_entry_id,erp._cp3_business_date(statement_timestamp()),'Reversal: '||v_old.description||' | '||p_reason,v_lines); UPDATE erp.journal_entries SET status='REVERSED' WHERE id=p_journal_entry_id; UPDATE erp.journal_entries SET reversal_of_id=p_journal_entry_id WHERE id=v_new_id; RETURN v_new_id; END; $function$

erp._cp7_current_credit_adjustment(uuid):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp._cp7_current_credit_adjustment(p_sale uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
declare h erp.sales_headers;m record;i numeric;u numeric;
begin
 select *into strict h from erp.sales_headers where id=p_sale;
 -- Preserve inactive/DRAFT document financial semantics: own Native P only.
 if h.status not in('POSTED','PARTIAL_PAID','PAID')then return 0::numeric;end if;
 select *into strict m from cp7_credit.current_leaf_assignment(p_sale);
 -- Legacy invoices/ordinary returns have no OW04 participation. Preserve the
 -- Native payment projection without inventing family order or requiring a
 -- retrofit of old posted returns. A protected journal cannot exploit this
 -- fast path: every such actual journal must have its exact retained link.
 if exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j
  where j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_RECOGNITION'and not exists(
   select 1 from cp7_credit.component_journals cj
    join cp7_credit.component_parts q on q.id=cj.part_id
    join cp7_credit.recognition_components cc on cc.id=q.component_id
    join cp7_credit.recognition_plans p on p.id=cc.plan_id
    join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=p.cohort_id
    join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id
   where cj.journal_id=j.id and q.id=j.source_id))
  or exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j
   where j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_REFUND'and not exists(
    select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
     join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=e.cohort_id
     join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id
    where e.journal_id=j.id and e.id=j.source_id and e.event_kind='REFUND'))
  or exists(select 1 from erp.journal_entries j where j.source_type in('CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_APPLY','CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_EVENT_REVERSE')
   and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events ce join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.id=ce.cohort_id
    join cp7_credit.return_families f on f.id=c.family_id where ce.journal_id=j.id and ce.id=j.source_id
     and((j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_APPLY'and ce.event_kind='APPLY'and ce.amount>0 and ce.restores_event_id is null)
      or(j.source_type='CP7_CUSTOMER_CREDIT_EVENT_REVERSE'and ce.amount<0 and ce.restores_event_id is not null))))then
  raise exception 'CP7_CREDIT_UNREPRESENTED_FINANCIAL_JOURNAL';end if;
 if not cp7_credit_note_carry_de.is_current_v1(p_sale)and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.return_families f where f.family_root_sale_id=m.root_sale_id)
  and not exists(select 1 from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
   where e.event_kind='APPLY'and cp7_credit_note_carry_de.effective_target_v1(e.id)=p_sale)then return 0::numeric;end if;
 if cp7_credit.payment_is_intermediate_v1(p_sale)then return cp7_credit.payment_intermediate_adjustment_v1(p_sale);end if;
 perform cp7_credit.assert_current_materialized_profile(p_sale,m.root_sale_id,m.current_leaf_id);
 -- Validator above proves ALL parts have actual journals; this join is not a
 -- silent filter permitting a partial pending plan to masquerade as actual I.
 select coalesce(sum(q.amount),0)into i
  from cp7_credit.return_families f join cp7_credit.cohorts c on c.family_id=f.id
  join cp7_credit.recognition_plans p on p.cohort_id=c.id
  join cp7_credit.recognition_components cc on cc.plan_id=p.id
  join cp7_credit.component_parts q on q.component_id=cc.id
  join cp7_credit.component_journals j on j.part_id=q.id
  where f.family_root_sale_id=m.root_sale_id;
 -- Signed restores are retained, not filtered away by amount/status. An
 -- advance-backed Native sales_payment is already P and is NOT another U.
 select coalesce(sum(e.amount),0)into u from cp7_credit.consumption_events e
  where e.event_kind='APPLY'and cp7_credit_note_carry_de.effective_target_v1(e.id)=p_sale;
 return u-i;
end $function$
cp7_payroll.settlement_access(text):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cp7_payroll.settlement_access(p_action text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare a jsonb;
begin
 a:=cp7_payroll.access_now('PAYROLL');
 if p_action not in('PREPARE','APPROVE','PAY','CANCEL','REVERSE') or p_action is null
  or(p_action in('PREPARE','APPROVE','CANCEL','REVERSE') and not erp.has_permission('finance.payroll.approve'))
  or(p_action in('PAY','REVERSE') and not erp.has_permission('finance.payroll.pay')) then
  raise exception using errcode='42501',message='CP7_PAYROLL_WRITE_DENIED';end if;
 return a;
end $function$
cp7_installment.meaning(uuid):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cp7_installment.meaning(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('header',to_jsonb(p)-array['status','payment_date','payment_cash_account_id','settled_at','updated_at','row_version'],
  'work',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)order by i.id)from erp.payroll_work_items i where i.payroll_id=p.id),'[]'),
  'attendance',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)order by i.id)from erp.payroll_attendance_items i where i.payroll_id=p.id),'[]'),
  'reimbursements',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)order by i.id)from erp.payroll_reimbursements i where i.payroll_id=p.id),'[]'),
  'deductions',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i)order by i.id)from erp.payroll_deductions i where i.payroll_id=p.id),'[]'))
 from erp.payroll_settlements p where p.id=p_id
$function$
erp.recalculate_payroll(uuid):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION erp.recalculate_payroll(p_payroll_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'erp', 'public'
AS $function$ DECLARE p erp.payroll_settlements%ROWTYPE;v_attendance_required boolean; BEGIN PERFORM erp.require_internal(); SELECT * INTO p FROM erp.payroll_settlements WHERE id=p_payroll_id FOR UPDATE; IF p.id IS NULL OR p.status NOT IN ('DRAFT','CALCULATED','REVIEW') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payroll cannot be recalculated in current status'; END IF; SELECT attendance_required INTO v_attendance_required FROM erp.contractors WHERE id=p.contractor_id; UPDATE erp.payroll_settlements SET labor_total=COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM erp.payroll_work_items WHERE payroll_id=p_payroll_id),0),attendance_total=CASE WHEN v_attendance_required THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM erp.payroll_attendance_items WHERE payroll_id=p_payroll_id),0) ELSE 0 END,reimburse_total=COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM erp.payroll_reimbursements WHERE payroll_id=p_payroll_id),0),deduction_total=COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM erp.payroll_deductions WHERE payroll_id=p_payroll_id),0),status='CALCULATED' WHERE id=p_payroll_id; END; $function$
